From: Sara Gomez <sara@murmurlabs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora cohort — pilot grant request & onboarding questions

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Murmur Labs is excited about the Aurora Accelerator cohort and we would love to move forward with a pilot on Redwood. The program asked us to request a pilot grant that covers usage through an initial product validation window (roughly 6–8 weeks).

A few specifics from our side:
- Initial scope: interactive assistant for customer support routing (avg 120 tokens/request, bursty traffic)
- Projected pilot volume: 150k tokens/mo, with spikes in weeks 2 and 5
- Ask: trial credit top-up to cover 3 months (or equivalent USD credit) and an option to extend by one month if usage milestone (10k active queries) is met

I attached our usage projections and a draft MOU the accelerator suggested. What information do you need from Redwood to move this through approvals? We have a cohort kickoff on June 24 and would like the environment ready before then.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call.

Sara Gomez
Co‑founder, Murmur Labs
sara@murmurlabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Subject: Fwd: Aurora cohort — pilot grant request & onboarding questions

Team — forwarding Murmur's ask (see attached). Quick summary: accelerator-backed startup requesting a 3‑month pilot credit (projected 150k tokens/mo) with a conditional 1‑month extension tied to usage milestone. Cohort kickoff 6/24.

Questions for approvals:
1) Can we allocate an equivalence of $10k (approx 200k tokens) as a one-time pilot grant with the option to add a 1‑month extension if milestone met?
2) Do we require a signed MOU or is a HubSpot deal + DocuSign sufficient for this program?
3) Any compliance or legal flags with Aurora's MOU?

I recommend we provision an isolated tenant under Dedicated Pilot for easier billing and logging (low overhead for this scale).

Next steps I propose: Aditya to confirm discount/credit approval, Marissa to confirm go-to-market references and HubSpot deal, Mateo to confirm any partner uplift requirements.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Startup Programs
Redwood Inference

Evelyn — thanks for the flag.

Summary of internal stance: we can approve a conditional pilot grant but want to codify the guardrails. Proposed terms:
- One-time credit: $10,000 USD applied to the account, intended to cover ~200k tokens of mixed gen/embeddings usage
- Extension: one additional month of the same credit value (not additive) if Murmur hits the 10k active queries milestone within 45 days
- Controls: provision to limit model class (e.g., medium latency open-models) and quota alarms after 80% consumption

Requirements before issuing credits: signed MOU or DocuSign acceptance of program terms and HubSpot deal record with billing contact. Legal to review Aurora_MOU_Draft (cc legal in HubSpot task).

I'll mark deal D-2026-0897 as \"pilot-approved-pending-docs\" and drop an approval note in the deal. Marissa, can you own communications with the accelerator ops? Mateo, if there are partner co-marketing asks we should capture them now.

- Aditya

Couple of operational notes from partnerships side:
- If we provide the $10k pilot, Aurora asks for a short co-marketing blurb and a 1‑pager reference after month 1 (standard in their accelerator guidelines). That should be fine but let's bake it into the MOU (language + opt-out).
- Recommend we enable prefix caching for Murmur's tenant and cap the max model family to one of our quantized open-model profiles to control cost/latency.
- I'll confirm whether Aurora needs a separate partner TOU; if so we should ensure it doesn't conflict with our legal.

If legal flags the MOU, we can offer Redwood's standard pilot MSA instead to speed things up.

— Mateo
